verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. It offers an OpenAI-compatible REST API, official server-side Python and Node SDKs, and a Batch API for asynchronous, non-interactive workloads. A Management API covers programmatic model and endpoint operations, and community users report driving it from scripts and tools (llm-cerebras plugin, agent routers). missing for 10: CI-specific documentation or examples (pipeline secrets/API-key handling), an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and evidence that free-tier rate limits hold up under automated load (one user hit per-minute limits instantly).
